$comment: The resources/list, resources/templates/list and prompts/list results of the server, each sorted. Generated: do not edit. After a deliberate change, run the tests with UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 and review the diff (see TESTING.md, "Tool surface snapshot").

resources.name: monitors
resources.title: Monitors
resources.description: The monitors as get_monitors returns them: bounds, work areas, scale factors, the primary monitor and the virtual screen.

resources.name: windows
resources.title: Windows
resources.description: The user-facing app windows, front to back, as find_windows with no filter returns them: handle, title, process, class, bounds, visible frame and state.

resourceTemplates.name: layout
resourceTemplates.title: Layout preset
resourceTemplates.description: A saved layout preset as get_layout returns it: each placement's window, monitor and position. A name no preset has is an error.

prompts.name: arrange_workspace
prompts.title: Arrange windows
prompts.description: Arrange windows on the user's monitors as described: find each window, then snap, place, move or maximize it, and check the result.

arguments.name: description
arguments.description: The arrangement, in the user's words (for example 'editor on the left half, browser on the right')

prompts.name: automate_app
prompts.title: Automate an app
prompts.description: Do a task in a Windows app with the locate, act and verify loop: find its window and elements, act through element refs, check each step.

arguments.name: app
arguments.description: The app, as the user names it (for example 'Notepad' or 'the Settings app')

prompts.name: diagnose_click
prompts.title: Diagnose a click
prompts.description: Find out why a click did nothing or hit the wrong thing: input paused, a blocking dialog, a covered or wrong point, a disabled control. Reads first, acts again only once the cause is known.

arguments.name: window
arguments.description: The window the click was meant for

arguments.name: symptom
arguments.description: What was clicked and what happened (for example 'clicked Save at 812,640, nothing happened')

prompts.name: fill_form
prompts.title: Fill in a form
prompts.description: Fill in a form in a window with the values given: find each field's element, set it through UI Automation, read it back, and submit only when asked.

arguments.name: window
arguments.description: The window with the form (for example 'the Contoso sign-up dialog')

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: The values to enter, field by field (for example 'Name=Ada Lovelace; Country=Norway')
